cases.label: 페이지 소비와 비동기 변환의 순서를 보존
cases.probe: const events=[];async function* source(){for(const value of [2,4,6]){events.push('pull:'+value);yield value;}}const result=await submission.collectPages(source(),3,async(value,index)=>{events.push('map:'+index);await Promise.resolve();events.push('done:'+index);return value+index;});observe({result,events});

cases.label: 상한 뒤에 추가로 읽지 않고 async finally를 기다린다
cases.probe: const events=[];async function* source(){try{for(const value of [1,2,3,4]){events.push('pull:'+value);yield value;}}finally{await Promise.resolve();events.push('closed');}}const result=await submission.collectPages(source(),2,value=>value*10);observe({result,events});

cases.label: 빈 입력과 기본 mapper의 페이지 경계
cases.probe: async function* empty(){}const page=Object.freeze([1,2]);async function* one(){yield page;}const result=await submission.collectPages(one(),4);observe({empty:await submission.collectPages(empty(),2),result,samePage:result?.[0]===page});

cases.label: mapper throw/rejection에서 원인과 생산자 정리를 유지
cases.probe: const outcomes=[];for(const asynchronous of [false,true]){const reason=new Error('map');const events=[];async function* source(){try{events.push('open');yield 1;events.push('overread');yield 2;}finally{await Promise.resolve();events.push('close');}}let same=false;try{await submission.collectPages(source(),5,()=>{if(asynchronous)return Promise.reject(reason);throw reason;});}catch(error){same=error===reason;}outcomes.push({same,events});}observe(outcomes);

cases.label: async generator의 실패와 자체 finally를 보존
cases.probe: const reason={code:'PAGE'};const events=[];async function* source(){try{yield 1;throw reason;}finally{events.push('producer-close');}}let same=false;try{await submission.collectPages(source(),4,value=>{events.push('map:'+value);return value;});}catch(error){same=error===reason;}observe({same,events});

cases.label: 잘못된 상한·mapper를 읽기 전에 거부
cases.probe: const outcomes=[];let reads=0;const source={async *[Symbol.asyncIterator](){reads++;yield 1;}};for(const limit of [0,-1,1.5,101,Infinity,'2']){try{await submission.collectPages(source,limit);outcomes.push('accepted');}catch(error){outcomes.push(error.name);}}try{await submission.collectPages(source,2,null);outcomes.push('accepted');}catch(error){outcomes.push(error.name);}observe({outcomes,reads});

cases.label: 첫 페이지가 falsy여도 상한을 하나로 센다
cases.probe: let pulls=0;let closed=0;async function* source(){try{for(const value of [0,false,'']){pulls++;yield value;}}finally{closed++;}}const result=await submission.collectPages(source(),1);observe({result,pulls,closed});
